Image Description: 

The image presents a white, pixelated oval shape against a black background. The oval shape is approximately centered in the image, taking up roughly half of its entire area. It has a thick, fuzzy outline that is slightly irregular in shape, giving it a hand-drawn appearance. The oval shape does not appear to be a letter or number, but rather a geometric figure with rounded edges. The black background provides a stark contrast to the white oval, making it stand out prominently.
